2607.08700.title: Do You Need a Frontier Model as a Citation Verifier? Benchmarking Rubric LLMs for Deep-Research Source Attribution
2607.08700.paper_summary: Reinforcement learning increasingly relies on an LLM judge to score each rubric criterion, and that judge acts as the reward model during training. Before such a signal can be trusted, we need to know how capable the judge must be and how biased it is. We study this calibration question for citation quality in deep-research systems, where a search-grounded LLM must support each claim it writes with a cited source. Citation quality is a structured rubric task in which each attribution-citation pair is judged along two dimensions that require an LLM, source relevance and factual support. On an adversarial long-form benchmark, we score 8 off-the-shelf LLM judges from 3 model families against gold labels over 1,248 rubric decisions, all of which were human-reviewed and 378 of which were hard cases adjudicated from judge disagreements. Cheaper judges remain competitive across both dimensions, with GPT-5-mini attaining the strongest source-relevance pass-class F1 at 0.908 ($κ$=0.636), while on factual support the judges are statistically indistinguishable (overlapping confidence intervals), so no single model dominates. At comparable F1, the judges still differ substantially in pass-rate drift, false positive rate, and false negative rate. Scalar F1 obscures this directional bias, yet it is exactly what a downstream reinforcement learning loop would reinforce. Calibrating the judge is therefore a prerequisite for using citation rubrics as reward signals, and our results show that this calibration does not require the most expensive available model.
2607.08700.paper_summary_zh: 強化學習越來越依賴於大型語言模型（LLM）評審來評分每個評分標準，而這個評審在訓練過程中充當獎勵模型。在這種信號可以被信任之前，我們需要了解評審必須具備多大的能力以及它的偏見程度。我們研究了在深度研究系統中引用質量的校準問題，在這裡，基於搜索的LLM必須用被引用的來源來支持它所寫的每一個主張。引用質量是一個結構化的評分任務，其中每個歸因-引用對在兩個維度上進行評判，這兩個維度需要LLM，即來源相關性和事實支持。在一個對抗性的長篇基準上，我們對來自三個模型家族的八個現成LLM評審進行評分，並將其與1,248個評分決策的金標籤進行對比，所有這些決策都經過人類審核，其中378個是由於評審之間的分歧而裁定的難題。較便宜的評審在這兩個維度上仍然具有競爭力，GPT-5-mini在來源相關性方面達到了最強的通過類別F1為0.908（$κ$=0.636），而在事實支持方面，評審在統計上無法區分（重疊的置信區間），因此沒有單一模型佔主導地位。在可比的F1下，評審在通過率漂移、假陽性率和假陰性率方面仍然存在顯著差異。標量F1掩蓋了這種方向性偏見，但這正是下游強化學習循環所會強化的。因此，校準評審是將引用評分作為獎勵信號的先決條件，我們的結果顯示，這種校準並不需要最昂貴的可用模型。
